page.overview:
Who is Ninora Birt?

Ninora Birt was a former freelance smuggler and owner of the Record Time. She joined the New Republic Defense Force during the Yuuzhan Vong War, serving in the Battle of Borleias as the captain of the Record Time and later as a pilot in Blackmoon Squadron under Luke Skywalker with the rank of Lieutenant.
